title: REST endpoints + service install
description:
## Parent

sutra/1 — prd for sutra watcher daemon

## What to build

Add REST endpoints to the existing axum router alongside `/mcp`: `GET /health` (200 + `{\"status\": \"ok\"}`, same pattern as yojana), `GET /status` (workspace list with last-parse times, staleness, file/symbol counts, smriti connection status), `POST /workspaces` (register a workspace, trigger parse if not already parsed).

Add `sutra install-services [--enable]` CLI command following smriti's pattern: writes `sutra.service` systemd user unit to `~/.config/systemd/user/`, runs `daemon-reload`, optional `enable --now`. Unit: `ExecStart=$HOME/.cargo/bin/sutra serve-http`, `Restart=always`, `RestartSec=2`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /health` returns 200 + `{\"status\": \"ok\"}`
- [ ] `GET /status` returns workspace list with freshness info
- [ ] `POST /workspaces` registers a new workspace and triggers parse if needed
- [ ] `sutra install-services` writes systemd unit file and reloads daemon
- [ ] `sutra install-services --enable` also enables and starts the service
- [ ] Verifiable: `curl localhost:3201/health` returns ok

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately."
